name: Traefik
description: Cloud-native HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer.
summary: AI-assisted contributions are welcome; substantial AI help needs an Assisted-by trailer. Agents must not post comments or replies, and drafted messages must be rewritten in your own voice. AI-found security reports need disclosure and a working proof of concept.

evidence.quote: Traefik welcomes AI-assisted contributions, provided a few simple rules are followed:
Declare substantial AI assistance with an `Assisted-by:` trailer at the bottom of the commit message whenever an agent produced a meaningful portion of the diff
disclose your use of AI tooling. Unvalidated AI-generated reports are closed immediately.
Do not let an agent post comments, review replies, or triage messages on your behalf. If an agent drafted a message for you, rewrite it in your own voice before sending
